capabilities: Generate an HTTPS redirect link for the active note via command palette
Copy the shareable link to the clipboard with toast feedback
Configure a custom redirect domain in settings
URL-encode vault and file names for special characters
Automate Cloudflare DNS and redirect-rule setup with a Python script
disambiguation: Not a link rewriter for links inside the vault; it only generates a new shareable HTTPS URL for the currently open note.
extras: Community-plugin listing is marked 'Coming Soon'; installation is currently manual via GitHub release files. Links only work after the user sets up their own Cloudflare redirect backend (automated script or manual DNS/redirect/security rules). README documents a known limitation: Cloudflare redirect rules run before WAF rules, so ../ path-traversal patterns in query strings cannot be validated server-side.
problem: Platforms like Slack, Notion, and web forums block or don't recognize Obsidian's custom obsidian:// URI scheme, so vault links can't be shared directly.

relations.evidence: transforms it to an HTTPS URL using a configurable redirect service

requires.name: Cloudflare account with API token and Zone ID

summary: Link generator that turns the active note's obsidian:// URI into an HTTPS redirect URL you can copy and share on external platforms.
